tool.name: Manage Shopify Product Images
tool.description: Upload, list, get, update, or delete images for a Shopify product. Upload supports imageUrl or Starships attachmentId (resolved to a preview URL) + optional metadata fields; base64 inputs are rejected.

alt.description: Shortcut: copied into image.alt if not set.

image.description: For upload/update: Shopify image object payload (e.g., {src, alt, position, variant_ids}). Merged with metadata (image wins). Note: base64 attachment fields are rejected.

imageUrl.description: For upload: public http(s) URL. For update: copied into image.src if provided.

metadata.description: For upload/update: arbitrary Shopify image fields to set ("metadata" meaning: any supported keys like alt, position, variant_ids, etc.). Merged into the image payload.

position.description: Shortcut: copied into image.position if not set.

operation.description: Action to perform on product images.

variantIds.description: Shortcut: copied into image.variant_ids if not set.

attachmentId.description: For upload: Starships attachment ID. The tool resolves it to a temporary preview URL via the Starships connector, then uploads to Shopify using image.src.
